blurb: Guests can rent kayaks, canoes, paddleboards, and other boats to explore the historic Lachine Canal. Guided tours and courses are available for all skill levels. Private group bookings and seasonal memberships are also offered.
extraNote: Located in the Lachine Canal National Historic Site, across the pedestrian bridge from the Atwater Market, near Lionel-Groulx and Charlevoix Métro stations.

quotes.text: What a nice team at H2O Adventures! There are lots of types of boats available for rent. I took a 3 hour guided tour that took us by kayak along the Lachine Canal from Atwater Market to the edge of old Montreal. The guide was knowledgeable and let individual kayakers paddle at their own pace. Going through the locks was a new and fun experience! You can see many birds and learn about the history of the canal and there is even time for a washroom break before heading back to home base. I highly recommend this outfitter for a different way to experience our city.

Great, unique experience and a highlight of my trip. The guide Dylan was friendly, knowledgable, and funny. Met a lovely group of people also on the tour and the brewery was excellent. Would recommend for a trip to Montreal!
